en: Self-hosted runner: Changed lifecycle hooks' git to skip a repository's Git LFS `pre-push` hook, ignore a writable system `core.hooksPath`, and not sign commits without `--configure-git`
zh: 自托管运行器：变更生命周期 hook 的 git，跳过仓库的 Git LFS `pre-push` hook，忽略可写的系统 `core.hooksPath`，且未指定 `--configure-git` 时不签名提交
